target_claim: Theorem A (Cycle-maximum uniqueness uniqueness of the MST). The following are equivalent: (i) G has a unique MST. (ii) For every cycle C subseteq G, the maximum-weight edge in C is unique.
source_quote: Theorem A (Cycle-maximum uniqueness uniqueness of the MST). The following are equivalent: (i) G has a unique MST. (ii) For every cycle C subseteq G, the maximum-weight edge in C is unique.
